basic_details.job_title: PRC Senior Research Analyst Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Population Research Centre (PRC), University of Kashmir, Srinagar has invited online applications for one temporary post of Senior Research Analyst (earlier Research Investigator), reserved for the SC category and open only to domiciles of the UT of Jammu & Kashmir. Pay is Level 6, Rs. 35400-112400/-. The essential qualification is at least a 2nd class Post Graduate Degree in a listed subject, with 3 years' experience in collection/ analysis and report writing. Online forms are accepted from 20 November 2026 to 18 December 2026, up to 4.00 p.m., at http://www.kashmiruniversity.ac.in.

application_fee.details: The fee is to be deposited through online mode only. The notice prints no separate fee deadline.

age_limit.details: Candidates must be not below 18 years. The upper limit differs by group: | Category Not Above Open Merit 40 years Physically Challenged candidates 42 years SC/ST-1/ST-2/BA/OBC/EWS/LAC/IB 43 years Substantive In-service State University Employees of the UT of J&K 50 years | There is no age bar for in-service candidates of the University of Kashmir. A 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Physically Handicapped Category candidates under Notification No. F(Res-Policy-Specially abled)KU/Gen. Admin dated 03.05.2017, if applicable. Ex-Servicemen are entitled to age relaxation and other benefits as admissible under the rules/orders issued by the Government of UT of Jammu & Kashmir from time to time. | For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

how_to_apply: Visit http://www.kashmiruniversity.ac.in, click the Jobs/Recruitment link and read the detailed instructions and the preview of the registration and application process.
Click the Register as an Applicant link and register with a valid email id and mobile number. Remember the username and password.
After registration, log in with the username and password.
Key in the personal details, educational qualifications and experience, then preview the form. Corrections can be made from the preview before submitting.
Click Submit. No editing or updating is allowed after the form is submitted.
Take a print out and note the Form No.
Deposit the application fee through online mode only.
Shortlisted applicants must produce the printout of the online form (hard copy), completed and duly self-attested, with supporting documents as and when asked.

Online applications open on 20 November 2026, the day after the notice date. Further information can be had from the office of the Coordinator, Population Research Centre, by email at [email protected].
Printout of the online application form (hard copy), self-attested.
All enclosures with the application form, self-attested.
Original documents relating to age, qualifications, experience, fitness and other claims, to be produced as and when asked.
important_instructions: The post is re-advertised because of poor response to the earlier notices dated 27-12-2024 and 08-05-2026. Candidates who applied against those notices must apply afresh, if otherwise eligible. Government servants must apply through the Administrative Authority concerned; University Teachers/Employees through the Registrar of their University; employees of private firms and institutions through the Head of the firm/institution. Applications not routed through the respective channel are liable to be rejected, but such candidates may send an advance copy at the earliest, followed by the application through proper channel. Applications received late, not in proper format or incomplete in any respect will not be entertained. Candidates should write their name strictly as per Matriculation/ Higher Secondary Certificates. Canvassing in any form by or on behalf of a candidate is a disqualification. Impersonation, or false, fabricated or tampered documents or incorrect statements, make a candidate liable for criminal prosecution. The University verifies the antecedents of documents at appointment or during service. If documents are fake or information is suppressed, services will be terminated forthwith and action taken under rules. The University reserves the right not to fill the post, if circumstances so warrant, without assigning any reason. Any addendum, corrigendum or notice will be uploaded on the University/ PRC website only, and no separate intimation will be given.

content_sections.heading: About the Population Research Centre
content_sections.text: The Population Research Centre functions under the University of Kashmir, Srinagar (J&K), whose notice states that it is accredited Grade "A++" by NAAC. The notice says the post is likely to continue with the continuation of the Centre by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The Centre's address is University Campus, Hazratbal, Srinagar (J&K)- 190006.

content_sections.heading: Vacancy Details
content_sections.text: The notice announces one post in total.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: A domicile of the UT of J&K is required. Knowledge in Computer Applications is required. Only candidates who fulfil the eligibility criteria on or before the last date of submission of applications should apply. Where the grading system is followed, a "B" grade is regarded as equivalent to 55% on the Seven Point Scale (B=Good, grade point 3.50-4.49, 55-64%). A relaxation of 5% may be provided, from 55% to 50% of the marks, to Ph.D. Degree holders who obtained their Master's Degree prior to 19th September, 1991. Candidates must be not below 18 years. The upper limit differs by group: There is no age bar for in-service candidates of the University of Kashmir. A 4% horizontal reservation is provided to Physically Handicapped Category candidates under Notification No. F(Res-Policy-Specially abled)KU/Gen. Admin dated 03.05.2017, if applicable. Ex-Servicemen are entitled to age relaxation and other benefits as admissible under the rules/orders issued by the Government of UT of Jammu & Kashmir from time to time. For the discipline-specific eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

rows.essential_qualification: At least 2nd class Post Graduate Degree in Demography/ Population Studies/ Statistics/ Biostatistics/ Economics/ Mathematics/ Sociology/ Social Work/ Psychology/ Anthropology/ Geography/ Public Health
rows.experience: 3 Years' experience in collection/ analysis and report writing (relaxable for candidates with higher qualifications)

rows.category: Substantive In-service State University Employees of the UT of J&K

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The post carries Level 6, Rs. 35400-112400/-. In addition to the Pay Level, D.A., Medical Allowance, House Rent and other allowances as admissible to the staff of the Population Research Centre are payable to the appointees. The post is temporary. The appointee is not entitled to GP fund/ pension; however, Contributory Provident Fund/ NPS/ gratuity and leave encashment will be applicable as permissible under the rules/ guidelines of the Ministry. Terms and conditions of appointment are governed by the Kashmir & Jammu Universities Act, 1969, and the Statutes & Regulations made under it from time to time, and the Union Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, whichever applicable.

content_sections.heading: Application Fee
content_sections.text: The fee is to be deposited through online mode only. The notice prints no separate fee deadline.

rows.details: Online application for Senior Research Analyst; forms accepted from 20-11-2026
Population Research Centre, University of Kashmir

faq.question: Q1. How many vacancies are there in PRC Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is one post, Senior Research Analyst (earlier Research Investigator), Post Code PGD-PR-9, reserved for the SC category.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply?
faq.answer: The last date for online forms is 18-12-2026, up to 4.00 p.m. The last date for submission of the hard copy is 24-12-2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for Senior Research Analyst at PRC?
faq.answer: A domicile of the UT of J&K and at least a 2nd class Post Graduate Degree in Demography, Population Studies, Statistics, Biostatistics, Economics, Mathematics, Sociology, Social Work, Psychology, Anthropology, Geography or Public Health. Knowledge in Computer Applications and 3 years' experience in collection/ analysis and report writing are also required.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: Not below 18 years as on 01.01.2026. The upper limit is 40 years for Open Merit, 42 for Physically Challenged candidates, 43 for SC/ST-1/ST-2/BA/OBC/EWS/LAC/IB and 50 for Substantive In-service State University Employees of the UT of J&K.

faq.question: Q5. What is the application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is Rs. 750 for Open Category and Rs. 500 for Reserved category, payable online only. Persons with benchmark disabilities (PwD) are exempted.

faq.question: Q6. What is the salary of the PRC Senior Research Analyst post?
faq.answer: The pay is Level 6, Rs. 35400-112400/-, plus D.A., Medical Allowance, House Rent and other allowances admissible to Population Research Centre staff.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Register at http://www.kashmiruniversity.ac.in through the Jobs/Recruitment link, fill and submit the online form, and pay the fee online. Shortlisted applicants later produce the self-attested printout with supporting documents when asked.

faq.question: Q8. How will candidates be selected?
faq.answer: Eligible candidates undergo screening/ shortlisting/ selection as determined by the University, which will be notified separately.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No, the post is temporary and likely to continue with the continuation of the Population Research Centre by the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare. The appointee is not entitled to GP fund/ pension.

faq.question: Q10. Must earlier applicants apply again?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates who applied against the notices dated 27-12-2024 and 08-05-2026 need to apply afresh against this advertisement, if otherwise eligible.
